7530.title: Oversized ACP catalogs prevent MCP subprocess launch
7530.rootCauseOneLine: The ACP builder serializes the full tool catalog into one environment entry, exceeding Linux's per-string process-launch limit before the MCP child can start.
7530.proposedFix: Move catalog delivery out of process startup metadata, then cover large-catalog discovery, calls, reconnect, and cleanup. No automatic PR: a robust repair requires a schema or private-file lifetime/security contract beyond the simple-fix safety gate.
7530.caveats: Same-agent second clean run confirmed the defect. No original user environment, full ACP session, tool invocation, or non-Linux system was tested. Both authored tests and their outputs are embedded in the HTML per reports repository policy.
